help.title: How to search
help.intro: Type words to search everywhere, or mix in filters. Click an example to try it.

submissions.text: Text anywhere: ref no., insured, risk, MGA, broker, country, line, notes. Part of a word is enough.
submissions.and: , means AND: every part must match
submissions.pipe: | inside a filter: any of these values
submissions.exclude: - excludes (a status, a filter or a word)
submissions.fields: Filters: status, mga, broker, lob, country, ccy, uw, type, ref
submissions.numbers: Numbers: our premium in USD, share %, si (sum insured, USD); k, m, bn
submissions.dates: Dates: received, inception, expiry, bound; ranges with ..
submissions.within: Within the next (or last) N days
submissions.keywords: Keywords: overdue, expired, noresponse, mine, today, thisweek, thismonth
submissions.notes: A word that is exactly a status, MGA, line or currency (bound, USD) filters by it; anything else is searched as text.
submissions.languages: Filter names and words work in English, Russian and Uzbek: статус:связан, holat:tasdiqlandi, валюта:usd, просрочено, bugun.

counterparties.text: Text anywhere: name, country, contacts (name, e-mail, phone), notes
counterparties.type: Type: MGA, broker or cedent; | for several
counterparties.notes: A word that is exactly a type or a country (broker, Uzbekistan) filters by it; anything else is searched as text.
counterparties.languages: Words work in English, Russian and Uzbek: тип:брокер, страна:Узбекистан, неактивные.

agenda.text: Text anywhere: title, submission ref no. and insured, MGA, outcome
agenda.due: Due within the next N days (or due:2026-11-01..2026-11-30)
agenda.assignee: Everyone’s follow-ups (admin and management; or assignee:Malika)
agenda.notes: Without assignee: your own follow-ups. today, thisweek and thismonth mean «due».
agenda.languages: Words work in English, Russian and Uzbek: просрочено, срок<7d, kechikkan.

users.inactive: Only inactive users (active: only active ones)
users.notes: A word that is exactly a role (finance) filters by it.
users.languages: Words work in English, Russian and Uzbek: роль:финансы, неактивные.

reference.text: Text anywhere: code and names in every language (all three tables)
reference.inactive: Only inactive rows (active: only active ones)
reference.notes: Filters currencies, countries and lines of business at once.
reference.languages: Words work in English, Russian and Uzbek.

fx.ccy: One currency (a bare code filters by it)
fx.source: Where the rate came from: manual or cbu
fx.notes: Searches all stored rates, not only the latest shown.
fx.languages: Words work in English, Russian and Uzbek: валюта:EUR, дата>=2026-10-01.
